name: Pokémon Unbound
notes: Boss teams: all 8 gym leaders use the Difficult (default) difficulty tables from unboundwiki.com, including levels, held items and moves as listed there (that wiki does not list abilities for gym leaders, so ability is null). Elite Four and Champion (Jax) teams are the only ones unboundwiki currently documents, and it documents them for Vanilla difficulty only, with levels listed "at cap" (the League scales to the player team; cap is Lv. 76) — abilities, items and moves are included as listed. Title Defense battles are excluded. Encounters: species pools with min/max levels per method (grass/surf/fishing/rock-smash) for the main-story areas of Borrius, extracted from game encounter data via the open-source Unbound-Pokedex project and cross-checked against the official Location Guide v2.1.0 (which lists the same pools without levels). Sub-floors/sub-maps of a location are merged into one area; day/night grass pools are merged into a single grass pool. Area order approximates main-story progression. Swarm, DexNav, special/static, raid and gift encounters are NOT included. The KBT Expressway encounter table could not be reliably matched to a named map in the extracted game data, so that corridor is omitted. Post-game-only maps (e.g. Battle Frontier, Cube Corp interiors) and maps whose internal names could not be matched to a location are omitted. Boss levels in Unbound scale with the player party within limits; the levels recorded here are the documented base/cap values.
